instruction: I maintain my work schedule in SimpleNote and track my tasks in Todoist. Every night, I delete the completed tasks from my "Today" project. Then, I move the maximum number of incomplete tasks from my Inbox to the "Today" project. The maximum here is assuming I work back-to-back as per my schedule and I find time for the left overs from the current day first. I am busy tonight, please do it for me. Note that the moved tasks must be identical to the original ones.
notes: The app simple_note is the domain constant simple-note. Tasks are modeled by representative objects: today-done-task (completed task in Today, to delete), today-leftover-task (incomplete task in Today, stays and consumes schedule time), inbox-fitting-task (incomplete Inbox task that fits the remaining schedule, to move) and inbox-overflow-task (incomplete Inbox task that does not fit, stays). The arithmetic selection (schedule minutes for the current day from the SimpleNote schedule minus leftover minutes, then greedily taking shortest Inbox tasks to maximize the count) cannot be expressed in STRIPS, so it is abstracted into the static fact (fits-in-schedule ...); the agent computes it at runtime and instantiates one create_task + delete_task pair per selected task and one delete_task per completed Today task. A 'move' is modeled as todoist.create_task in Today copying title/description/duration/duration_unit/priority (identity enforced by the task-* attribute facts) followed by todoist.delete_task of the original; create_task requires the schedule to be read and both project task lists to be listed, mirroring the information needed for the decision. Leftover/overflow tasks cannot be deleted or copied because to-delete is only true for completed Today tasks or copied Inbox tasks and copying requires fits-in-schedule, so the goal only needs the positive conditions. supervisor-complete-task takes the record objects as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; complete_task is called without an answer.
